card.name: End of uppercase dateline city names
card.fires_on: The last piece of an all-caps city name at the start of a news article, such as the dateline before a wire-service credit or colon. It also fires weakly on the end of other all-caps headings.

modes.label: Dateline city
modes.description: Final piece of a capitalized city name opening a news story.

modes.label: Caps heading end
modes.description: The end of an all-caps title or organization name at the start of a text.

card.plain: It notices when an all-caps city name, like a news dateline, is ending, just before the article text starts.
